title: 第16章 留面子第17章 我怕水晶球承受不起
lines: “哈哈，没想到这次的测试竟然这么简单！”
“简单？
我看不一定！你们因为是第一次参加不知道。
这个项目，我曾经在家族的外府子弟测试中见过，这颗灵脉水晶球会根据每个人灵脉的强弱，以及自己灵脉力量的掌握强度的多少，凝聚出不同的星辰来，而只有凝聚出六颗星辰的人，才能算是通过。”
“曾经有人虽然前面的战绩颇佳，但因为最终没能够凝炼出六颗星辰，导致最后四轮的总成绩不佳，不得不继续呆在外府，等待来年的机会。”
说话的是一名青年，显然当初他也是因为无法凝聚出六颗星辰，而只能一直呆在外府的江家子弟。
闻言，众人面面相觑，尽皆沉默了下来。
“我先来！”
而就在这时，一名粗犷的少年率先走了出去。
“是江承！他可是开脉境七重的强者。”
“想来这一次定能够成功凝聚六颗星辰。”
见到江承上台，众人纷纷看好。
江承来到台上，没有犹豫，手掌之上蕴含着灵力的一掌便是猛然落下。
一声巨大的声响顿时从那颗灵脉水晶球上传了出来。
下一刻，那颗水晶球上顿时绽放出了一道万丈光芒。
江承面色大喜，然而下一瞬间他就感觉到一股巨大的反震力顿时从那水晶球上喷涌而出，落到了他的身上。
“噗嗤！”
恐怖的力道顿时令得江承面色一白，一口鲜血狂喷而出，而他本人则被这股力量震出高台。
“该死！”
那江承愤怒的嘶吼着，他已经看出来了，那水晶球上还蕴藏着反震力，自己刚刚一个不慎，竟然就这样出局了。
“嘶”见到这一幕，所有的人面色变得凝重了起来，看来这灵脉水晶球的测试并没有想象中那么容易啊！“下一位！”
随着二长老的声音再度响起，一位黝黑的少年也再次走上可高台。
“是江可，外府排名第六的高手，不知道他能不能通过。”
那些江家子弟纷纷表示担忧，毕竟在之前那江承可是被一举击落到了台下。
而来到台上的江可，他的手掌弥漫着一股青色的灵力，随后对便是对着水晶球上一拍。
低沉的闷响声再次回荡在这片广场的上空，旋即那股巨大的反震力再度席卷而出，落到那少年的身上。
不过，因为有了前一个的经验，江可明显做了准备，身体之上只见有光芒闪耀，将那落在身上的力量尽数化解，紧接着他的上空一颗颗硕大的星辰便疯狂凝聚。
一颗两颗六颗最后，当那星辰凝聚到六颗的时候，光芒终于暗淡了下来。
“不愧是我外府中排名第六的存在，若是换作寻常人恐怕根本无法一掌打出六颗星辰来。”
content_en:
"Haha, I didn't expect this test to be so easy!"
"Easy?
I don’t think so! You don’t know because it’s your first time participating.
I have seen this project in the test of the family's waifu disciples. This spiritual vein crystal ball will condense different stars according to the strength of each person's spiritual veins and the strength of their own spiritual veins. Only those who condense six stars can pass. "
"There was once a person who had a good record in the past, but because he was not able to condense six stars in the end, his overall results in the last four rounds were poor, and he had to stay in the outside world and wait for the opportunity in the coming year."
The person who spoke was a young man. Apparently, he was also a member of the Jiang family who could only stay outside because he was unable to condense six stars.
Hearing this, everyone looked at each other and fell silent.
"I'll go first!"
At this moment, a rough young man walked out first.
"It's Jiang Cheng! He is a strong man at the seventh level of the Pulse Opening Realm."
"I think I will be able to successfully condense six stars this time."
Seeing Jiang Cheng take the stage, everyone was optimistic.
Jiang Cheng came to the stage and without hesitation, a palm containing spiritual power suddenly fell down.
"Bang!"
A huge sound suddenly came from the spiritual crystal ball.
"Buzz!"
The next moment, a beam of light burst out from the crystal ball.
Jiang Cheng looked overjoyed, but the next moment he felt a huge repulsive force spurting out from the crystal ball and falling on him.
"Pfft!"
The terrifying force immediately made Jiang Cheng's face turn pale, a mouthful of blood spurted out, and he himself was shaken off the high platform by this force.
"Damn it!"
Jiang Cheng roared angrily. He had already seen that the crystal ball still contained counter-shock power. He had just been careless and was out of the game like this.
"Hiss" Seeing this scene, everyone's expressions became solemn. It seems that the test of the spiritual vein crystal ball is not as easy as imagined! "Next one!"
As the second elder's voice sounded again, a dark-skinned young man stepped onto the high platform again.
"It's Jiang Ke, the sixth-ranked master in the foreign government. I don't know if he can pass."
The children of the Jiang family expressed concern. After all, Jiang Cheng was shot down from the stage before.
When Jiang Ke came to the stage, his palms were filled with cyan spiritual power, and then he slapped the crystal ball.
"Bang!"
The low muffled sound echoed over the square again, and soon the huge counter-shock force swept out again and fell on the young man.
However, because of the previous experience, Jiang Ke was obviously prepared. There was only light shining on his body, dissolving all the power falling on him, and then the huge stars above him began to condense crazily.
One, two, six. Finally, when the stars condensed to six, the light finally dimmed.
"Wow!"
"As expected of him, he is the sixth-ranked being in my outer palace. If it were an ordinary person, he probably wouldn't be able to shoot out six stars with one palm."
title_en: Chapter 16 Saving Face Chapter 17 I’m Afraid the Crystal Ball Can’t Bear It
